dish.title: Chipotle Lime Black Bean Bowls
dish.name: Chipotle Lime Black Bean Bowls
dish.description: Chipotle-lime black beans over quinoa with corn, salted in each component and finished with lime.

recipe.provenance_note: Legacy menu text of unknown origin. This draft reconciles that text. It does not claim a kitchen test.

recipe_version.title: Chipotle Lime Black Bean Bowls
recipe_version.description: Chipotle-lime black beans over quinoa with corn, salted in each component and finished with lime.
recipe_version.serving_basis_note: Quantities are for 4 servings. One- and two-serving floors are not in this draft.
recipe_version.doneness: Quinoa tender with a white ring. Beans hot and coated, not soupy.

ingredients.name: quinoa
ingredients.note: Dry, rinsed. Cooks to about 2 cups.

ingredients.name: chipotle in adobo
ingredients.note: Minced chipotle, plus 1 tbsp adobo sauce from the same can.

ingredients.name: lime
ingredients.note: Juice of 1 in the beans. The second lime is wedges.

ingredients.name: corn
ingredients.note: Kernels, canned and drained or frozen and thawed.

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: In the beans so the chipotle coats instead of steaming.

ingredients.name: Diamond Crystal kosher salt
ingredients.note: Divided: 2 g in the quinoa water (about 0.6% of 1.33 cups, and that water is absorbed), 3 g in the beans, 1 g on the corn. 6 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt (2.25 tsp). The same weight is 1.25 tsp Morton coarse kosher salt or 1 tsp table salt. UC ANR publication 390575 (November 2023): Diamond Crystal kosher salt 2.8 g per teaspoon, Morton coarse kosher salt 4.8 g per teaspoon, table salt 6 g per teaspoon.

steps.title: Cook the quinoa
steps.body: Rinse the quinoa. Simmer it covered in the water with 2 g of the Diamond Crystal kosher salt, about 15 minutes, until the grains are tender and the water is absorbed (about 0.6% salt, because that water stays in the grain). Rest covered 5 minutes, then fluff.

steps.title: Simmer the beans
steps.body: Warm the neutral oil, stir in the ground cumin and the chipotle in adobo for 30 seconds, then add the black beans, 3 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt, and the juice of 1 lime. Simmer 10 minutes, until the beans are hot and coated. Taste a bean, which is fully cooked, and add a pinch more salt only if the chipotle still tastes flat. Cut the second lime into wedges.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.body: Toss the corn with the remaining 1 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt. Layer quinoa, beans, and corn. Add the lime wedges.

recipe_version.dietary_label_note: Dairy-free because there is no cheese, crema, or sour cream. Canned chipotle in adobo is not contracted, so the meal is not marked plant and not marked HH001-eligible. The legacy dietary tag bowl is a format, not a diet.
allergen_notes: No egg, milk, sesame, peanut, tree_nut, shellfish, or finfish in the quinoa, black beans, corn, or lime. Canned chipotle in adobo is not contracted, so this package does not confirm anchovy, wheat, or soy and does not add them as allergens.
The allergen array stays empty. Notes do not replace the array.

changes_from_v1: The assemble step said toppings and listed none. v2 allows only quinoa, beans, corn, and the second lime.
Quinoa was 2 cups cooked, with no dry measure and no water. v2 uses 2/3 cup dry quinoa and 1 1/3 cups water.
The bean simmer had no time and no heat. v2 simmers 10 minutes. Cans were unnamed. v2 uses 15 oz cans, drained and rinsed.
1 tsp minced chipotle had no simmer liquid. v2 adds 1 tbsp adobo sauce from the same can. Drafter amount.
Two limes were unsplit. v2 puts the juice of one in the beans and cuts the second into wedges.
Clock was prep 15 plus cook 25 equals 40, and the chip said 30. v2 is prep 10 plus cook 20 equals 30, beans inside the quinoa clock.
The tacos spark was dropped. This is a bowl. No tortilla was added.
